name: Mind
description: Your second brain. Persistent memory across AI sessions — people, projects, decisions, wins, competencies, and more. Every record links to the others, so the graph builds itself as you work.

ai.systemPrompt: Mind is a personal-memory app. Its 16 memory_* collections (people, teams, projects, meetings, decisions, incidents, action_items, wins, competencies, evidence, reviews, goals, topics, patterns, gotchas, notes) are designed for an AI agent to write into as the user talks. When the user mentions a person, decision, win, or anything else memory_* can hold, create or update the relevant record AND populate every x-ref field that applies — peopleIds, projectIds, competencyIds, etc. The graph is the point: a record without links is a bug. Use the markdown `description` field on each record as the primary content.
